name: Silicon oxide diffusion mask
summary: Frosch and Derick found that a silicon dioxide layer could shield silicon and confine dopants to chosen areas, a key step toward patterned chip manufacture.
description: Frosch and Derick used silicon dioxide to protect wafers and delimit dopant diffusion through etched openings.
